prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny green meadow full of wildflowers with a dirt path, a wooden fence and gate of normal height, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Uzbek woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a jewelled brow ornament, deep red lips, warm olive skin, a regal composed expression, pure icy-white hair styled in sleek straight, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large platinum hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a silver miniature anvil, a gold hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten gold rings. Extra long nails in matching polished wenge wood.
LEFT Physique: most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: full body near-black wenge wood carved directly over her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, this is solid carved wood curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING near-black wenge grain across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID gold-tan pinstripes running between the carved sections, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Her face stays real living skin and the carving ends cleanly at the neck.
LEFT Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme thigh-high platform stiletto boots carved from the same wenge wood, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Uzbek man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, deep plum smoky eyes with dark lashes, fair olive skin with a warm undertone, a soft amused smile, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in low bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a silver cube-shaped block, a silver ship's anchor, a gold hammer head, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered rose-gold necklaces. RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His body carries a dense printed-circuit surface grown over his skin, raised copper traces and solder pads running in tidy right-angled lines over every curve, tiny rectangles of black silicon chips set into the surface, BLAZING glossy white ceramic circuit-board surface with silver traces, VIVID magenta light pulses racing along the traces and small glowing LED points. It is fused to his own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme white platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
